events.name: Bash
events.head: Survey patches, doc, clones and Docker state
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan; ls -la tantra-product-patches tantra-product-patches/*/ | head -60; wc -l pipeline/agentic-dev-cycle.md tantra-product-patches/README.md; ls ~/Documents/GitHub | head -30; docker info 2>&1 | head -3; grep -n -i "band\|no data\|dogfood\|tier" pipeline/agentic-dev-cycle.md | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the pitch doc and patches README
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan; cat pipeline/agentic-dev-cycle.md; echo ----; cat tantra-product-patches/README.md | head -60

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read rest of the pitch doc and README
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan; sed -n 22,78p pipeline/agentic-dev-cycle.md | cut -c1-900; echo ----; sed -n 1,45p tantra-product-patches/README.md | cut -c1-400

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check backend clone state, Docker daemon, and the premerge/preview patch
events.input: $ cd ~/Documents/GitHub/tantra-backend-v2 && git status -sb | head -8; git branch | head -30; git log --oneline -3; git stash list | head -3; (docker info 2>&1 | grep -i "server version\|cannot connect\|error" | head -3); cat /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan/tantra-product-patches/tantra-backend-v2/ci_premerge-and-preview--f0b901e.patch | sed -n 1,200p

events.name: Bash
events.head: Start Docker, read the rest of the doc, find any earlier scratch copy
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan; open -a Docker 2>&1 | head -2; sed -n 34,78p pipeline/agentic-dev-cycle.md | cut -c1-700; echo ----; grep -o "/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]*tmp[A-Za-z0-9_./-]*backend[A-Za-z0-9_./-]*" tasks/activity/T-154.json | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -8; ls -d /tmp/*tantra* /tmp/*backend* ~/Documents/GitHub/*scratch* 2>/dev/null | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check recent commits on task files and whether preview was already run
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan; git log --format='%h %ad %s' --date=format:'%m-%d %H:%M' -8 -- pipeline/agentic-dev-cycle.md tantra-product-patches pipeline/dash.py | cut -c1-230; git status --short pipeline tantra-product-patches bugs | head; sed -n 49p pipeline/agentic-dev-cycle.md | cut -c690-2500; grep -n "local preview\|preview-up\|premerge-green" pipeline/agentic-dev-cycle.md pipeline/dash.py | cut -c1-200 | head; date; docker info 2>&1 | grep -i "server version\|error" | head -2
